scientific_integrity: A mathematical theorem with an explicit proof and finite numerical stress-tests; no independent scientific audit has been performed. The 2025 preprint is the verified first public source, not the later journal date.
scientific_limitations: Strict inequalities concern subgroup composition within one fixed-force, transient leaky-immunity epidemic. No counterfactual intervention monotonicity or exact closed-form subgroup reinfection counts are claimed. Inaccessible older full texts remain a priority risk. Numerical examples approximate the infinitesimal-seed limit.
title: Strict subgroup reinfection bounds distinguish leaky and all-or-none vaccination
